Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

Score Step 3 of the SFCC-236 build (ZimmProductPrice isLive opt-out prop) — round 1.

Files: overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/{index.tsx,index.test.tsx} — both existing files, modified only.

## Orchestrator verdict: IN SCOPE
Exactly 2 files dirty in the whole repo. Both render branches (loaded + loading/skeleton) gated identically via a single `liveRegionProps` local. Default-path parity backed by 4 pre-existing, unmodified test assertions. Exactly 2 new tests added, zero existing test lines changed (verified via `-U0` diff showing pure insertions). No Tier 1/2 file touched, no theme registration change.

## Tester verdict: no CONFIRMED or PLAUSIBLE defects found
Two required falsifications performed and both succeeded as expected:
1. Hardcoded `liveRegionProps` to always include both attributes (ignoring `isLive`) — exactly the 2 new tests failed, all 10 others stayed green. Reverted, byte-identical diff confirmed.
2. Flipped the default to `isLive=false` with no call-site change — 3 pre-existing tests failed (stronger than requested: proves the default is protected on both branches, not just one). Reverted, byte-identical, full suite re-confirmed at 49 files/738 tests.

Also confirmed: TypeScript narrowing on `liveRegionProps` is literal-typed (`'polite'`/`'true'`, not widened to `string`); the one real consumer (`zimmProductContent`) doesn't pass `isLive` and is unaffected (verified by reading its render, not mocking — its own test coverage is story-`play`-only, asserts nothing about ARIA, so no update needed there); full-repo grep found no second consumer; no `.css.ts`/styling touched (vacuous, correctly dropped rather than padded); no rendered pixels change in either branch (visual checkpoint correctly judged vacuous — ARIA attributes have no visual footprint, so nothing for Marcel to look at in DevTools).

One forward-looking note (not a defect in this step): the `isLive` prop has no consumer yet — the eventual product-card component that needs it (built in Step 4/6) doesn't exist yet. Worth confirming later that it actually gets wired up, since an unused opt-out defeats its own purpose. Not blocking now.

## Your job
Score all six axes. This step is small, clean, and both required falsifications succeeded — decide whether this warrants the same depth of scrutiny as the larger steps or whether a lighter-touch PASS is appropriate given: (a) it's an existing, already-shipped, well-tested component, (b) the change is strictly additive with a safe default, (c) both angles independently verified the default path via real mutation testing (not just reading), (d) the plan itself flagged this step as "independently droppable" / low-risk.

Give PASS or REWORK. If PASS, note explicitly whether Design Fidelity applies here at all (Tester/Orchestrator both judged it vacuous — no rendered-output change) — if you agree, this step doesn't need a visual checkpoint before committing, unlike Steps 1-2. If REWORK, be specific and bounded as always.

This atom does no formatting of its own so it stays usable from Storybook 34 * without an intl provider. 35 * — Full price: the only price shown. 36 * — On sale: rendered as the "Now" figure alongside `originalPrice`. 37 * 38 * Optional because the page's mapper resolves an absent price to `''` rather than to a 39 * formatted `NaN` — see `pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts`'s `selectPdpProductInfo` and 40 * the assertion it carries in `productInfo.test.ts`. That empty string reaches this atom 41 * unchanged and the decision not to render is taken here. 42 */ 43 currentPrice?: string; 44 /** 45 * The original full price before the sale, formatted the same way as `currentPrice`. 46 * When supplied the atom switches to the Was/Now sale treatment (PRC-09): 47 * "Was {originalPrice} Now {currentPrice}". Absent for full-price items. 48 */ 49 originalPrice?: string; 50 /** 51 * When true, renders an empty container instead of the price — used while a variant 52 * re-fetch is in progress to preserve the layout slot without showing stale Was/Now values. 53 */ 54 isLoading?: boolean; 55 /** 56 * Opt out of the WCAG 4.1.3 live-region announcement (`aria-live`/`aria-atomic`) entirely. 57 * Defaults to `true` so every existing caller (the PDP, where a variant swap needs to be 58 * announced) keeps today's behaviour unchanged with no code change on their end. Pass `false` 59 * when this atom is reused inside a grid of many cards (e.g. a PLP) where the price never 60 * changes after mount, so a live region adds DOM/AT overhead for no benefit — the attributes 61 * are omitted entirely in that case, not set to `aria-live="off"`. 62 */ 63 isLive?: boolean; 64 }; 65 66 /** 67 * Atom — the single, full product price. All styling, type included, lives in 68 * `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` and is consumed through the theme, per the 69 * one-canonical-styling-surface rule. Type in particular must stay there rather than on the 70 * element, or SFCC-194's `sale` variant cannot override it with a composite `textStyle` of its 71 * own — see that file's docblock. 72 * 73 * Renders nothing when there is no price, so a caller can place it unconditionally — the same 74 * contract as `ZimmProductDescription`. Rendering an empty `

` instead would still take a 75 * flex `gap` in `ZimmProductContent`'s column, leaving a hole where the price should be. 76 */ 77 export const ZimmProductPrice = ({ currentPrice, originalPrice, isLoading, isLive = true }: ZimmProductPriceProps) => { 78 // During loading, always use the sale variant so the flex row + two-span structure is rendered 79 // (invisible) — this preserves the exact Was/Now dimensions while the fetch is in flight. 80 const variant = isLoading || originalPrice ? 'sale' : 'default'; 81 82 // Guard below the hook, never above it: an early return before `useMultiStyleConfig` makes 83 // the hook call conditional, which `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` reports as an error rather 84 // than a warning. Same ordering as `ZimmProductDescription` and `ZimmProductStyleCode`. 85 const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_PRICE_RECIPE, { variant }); 86 // `intl.formatMessage`, not a destructured `{ formatMessage }`: destructuring a method off 87 // `useIntl()` trips `@typescript-eslint/unbound-method`. See `zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx` 88 // for the established pattern and why `useUiCopy` is wrong here. 89 const intl = useIntl(); 90 91 // `isLive` gates both render paths below identically — omitted entirely when `false`, not 92 // set to `aria-live="off"`, since a card-grid reuse (SFCC-236) has no live-region need at all 93 // rather than an explicitly-disabled one. 94 const liveRegionProps: { 'aria-live'?: 'polite'; 'aria-atomic'?: 'true' } = isLive 95 ? { 'aria-live': 'polite', 'aria-atomic': 'true' } 96 : {}; 97 98 // Preserve the full Was/Now layout slot while a variant re-fetch is in progress. 99 // opacity:0 keeps the element in the flow (height + gap retained), hides the placeholder 100 // content visually, and keeps it in the accessibility tree — so AT registers the live 101 // region before the price arrives and announces the update when the fetch settles. 102 // visibility:hidden was not used: it removes the element from the AT, defeating the 103 // live-region purpose even though aria-hidden is absent. 104 if (isLoading) { 105 return ( 106 107 108 109 ); 110 } 111 112 if (!currentPrice) return null; 113 114 return ( 115 /* 116 * `aria-live`/`aria-atomic` sit on the price element itself, so this atom still renders 117 * exactly one node. 118 * 119 * WCAG 2.2 AA 4.1.3 (Status Messages) is the requirement. Choosing a variant rewrites the 120 * URL's `pid` (`pages/product-detail/index.tsx` lines 379-389), which re-keys the 121 * `useProduct` call on line 204 and hands this atom a different string. Focus never moves, 122 * so without a live region the price is repainted silently and a screen-reader user is never 123 * told the number they are buying at has changed. React mutates this element's text in 124 * place, which is exactly the change a live region reports; `aria-atomic` makes it read the 125 * whole price rather than only the characters that differ. 126 * 127 * Base `display-price/current-price.jsx` instead puts the announcement in a second, hidden 128 * node (its lines 57-66). A 146 whitespace-only flex item adds no width (CSS Flexbox §4), so the recipe's `gap` 147 remains the only visual spacing between the spans. 148 */}{' '} 149 150 {intl.formatMessage(NOW_PRICE_MESSAGE, { price: currentPrice })} 151 152 153 ) : ( 154 currentPrice 155 )} 156 157 ); 158 }; 159

content.text:
## Score: SFCC-236 Step 3 — ZimmProductPrice `isLive` opt-out — Round 1

| Axis | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Design fidelity** | **N/A — vacuously satisfied** | Diff touches only attribute presence (`aria-live`/`aria-atomic` spread vs. omitted), confirmed by reading every changed hunk in `index.tsx`. No JSX structure, `styles.*` reference, `.css.ts`, or `textStyle` changed — `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` doesn't appear in the diff at all. ARIA attributes have no rendered footprint. Agree with Tester/Orchestrator: no visual checkpoint is required before this can be committed, unlike Steps 1-2. |
| **Pass criteria** | PASS | `isLive` added, default `true`, JSDoc states the WCAG 4.1.3 rationale (`index.tsx:55-63`). Single `liveRegionProps` local gates both call sites identically (`index.tsx:94-96`, spread at line 106 and line 136) — verified by reading both, not inferred. |
| **Correctness** | PASS | I ran these myself, not just re-read the Tester's numbers: `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero output. `npx vitest run` (full suite, no filter) — **49 files / 738 tests, all green**, exact match to the Tester's figure. Targeted run of the file alone — 12/12 green. |
| **Conformance** | PASS | No styling touched → styling hierarchy and `audit:tokens` are moot (confirmed: `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` returns no `zimmProductPrice` hits). `liveRegionProps` is narrow-typed (`'polite'`/`'true'` literals, not widened to `string`) — correct per typescript.md, no `any`/`as`/`!`. Optional prop uses `?` per components.md. No new imports, no structural change. |
| **Completeness** | PASS | Story already exists pre-step (components.md requirement was already met). No new named story export is required for `isLive=false`: it produces zero visible difference in the canvas and no interactive behaviour for a `play` function to exercise — testing.md's "pick the cheapest layer" correctly puts this at Vitest, which is where it landed. 2 new tests cover both render branches; 0 existing test lines altered. |
| **Restraint** | PASS (for the reviewed diff) — see flag below | Exactly the opt-out prop, nothing else. `zimmProductContent/index.tsx:58` confirmed by direct read: calls `<ZimmProductPrice currentPrice={...} originalPrice={...} isLoading={isPriceLoading} />` — no `isLive` passed, default path untouched. Repo-wide `grep -rn "isLive"` outside the two reviewed files returns nothing — confirms no second consumer and no premature wiring. |

## Overall: PASS

## What I tried to falsify

I didn't just re-read the Tester's two mutations — I independently reproduced the full test suite and TypeScript check myself (results above), then added one falsification angle the Tester's report didn't cover: whether `isLive` behaves identically whether it's **explicitly passed `true`** or **left to default**, and whether the opt-out survives a **loading→loaded rerender** (not just two static renders). I built this as a temporary co-located `.test.tsx` (required — Vitest's include glob rejects paths outside `overrides/**`, so a scratchpad-only file is never actually executed by this harness, which is itself worth knowing), ran it, then deleted it and confirmed via `git status` that only the two intended files remained dirty:

- `withDefault.innerHTML === withExplicitTrue.innerHTML` — byte-identical, rules out a default-binding bug where "true via default" and "true via explicit prop" diverge.
- `isLive={false}` through a loading→loaded `rerender()` — same DOM node reused (`toBe(region)`), `aria-live`/`aria-atomic` absent at both ends of the transition. This is a real combination the two shipped tests don't exercise (they each check one static render, not a transition), and it passed.

Both attempts survived. Combined with the Tester's two mutation-kills (ignore-`isLive` → both new tests failed; flip-the-default → 3 pre-existing tests failed), that's four independent break-attempts against this small a change, all of which correctly failed. I judge that sufficient — a further mutation pass would be re-testing the same two-line conditional a fifth way for no new information, which is the "same depth of scrutiny as the larger steps" question the brief raised. Lighter-touch is warranted here, but "lighter-touch" meant *fewer* falsification angles, not *zero independent verification* — everything above was re-run by me, not taken on the Tester's word.

## What I could not verify — and a flag outside the six axes

Nothing in the reviewed diff itself is unverifiable — tsc, the full suite, the sole consumer, and the absence of a second consumer are all directly confirmed, not inferred.

**Flag: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.stories.tsx` is now dirty, and it is not part of Step 3.** My very first command this session (`git status --porcelain=v1`, before touching anything) showed only the two files the Orchestrator names. Partway through this review it picked up an unrelated diff — a dead `args: { currentPrice: "", originalPrice: "" }` block added to the `AcrossStorefrontCurrencies` story (which the story's own `render` ignores entirely — it hardcodes prices in JSX, not via `args`), double-quoted in a single-quote codebase, with a trailing comma stripped. That signature, plus a live `storybook dev -p 6006` process already running against this exact repo (`ps aux`, started 7:32PM, well before my session), points to a Controls-panel "save changes" writeback from someone interacting with the running Storybook UI concurrently with this review — not anything I ran, and not part of the Implementer's Step 3 work.

I did not touch or revert this file — it isn't mine to fix, and it may be legitimate in-progress work at the keyboard. But it means the Orchestrator's "exactly 2 files dirty in the whole repo" is **no longer true as of right now**, through no fault of Step 3. Before this gets committed: `git add` the two named files explicitly (not `-A`/`.`), and separately decide whether to keep or discard the stray `args` stub on `AcrossStorefrontCurrencies` — it's inert either way (the story doesn't read `args`), but it shouldn't ride along in this step's commit unexamined.

## Biggest residual risk in shipping this step

The prop is unconsumed. `isLive` is fully correct and fully tested but wired to nothing yet — the PLP card that needs `isLive={false}` doesn't exist until Step 4/6. The risk isn't in this step's code; it's process risk that a later step forgets to pass it, silently shipping a live region into every PLP card exactly as documented in this step's own JSDoc rationale (`index.tsx:59-61`). Worth a one-line callback in Step 4/6's acceptance criteria, not a blocker here.
